en_title: God of War Laufey Delayed to May 2027
opus_summary: 圣莫妮卡工作室将《战神：劳菲》的发售日期从2027年2月16日推迟至5月20日，称需要更多时间打造符合玩家期待的作品，并将在近期公布更多详情。此前宣布的收藏盒是否也会延期尚不清楚，另一款以奎托斯为主角的《战神》新作也正在开发中。

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey will no longer be released in February, as Sony Santa Monica has pushed it back to May 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：劳菲》将不再于2月发售，索尼圣莫妮卡工作室已将其延期至2027年5月。

paragraphs.en: The game will now be released on May 20, 2027, with the studio stating that it needs more time to make something that meets fan expectations. The studio also confirmed it would share more details on the game soon. It's possible we'll see something at The Game Awards, but there could also be a new State of Play before the end of the year or very early 2027 that may reveal more about the next God of War game.
paragraphs.cn: 这款游戏现将于2027年5月20日发售，工作室表示需要更多时间来打造符合粉丝期待的作品。工作室还确认将很快分享更多游戏详情。我们有可能在The Game Awards上看到一些内容，但今年年底前或2027年初也可能会有一场新的State of Play，届时或许会公布更多关于下一款《战神》游戏的信息。

paragraphs.en: An update regarding God of War Laufey's release date. https://t.co/qCw9O3dqtR
paragraphs.cn: 关于《战神：劳菲》发售日期的最新消息。https://t.co/qCw9O3dqtR

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey had previously been slated to release on February 16, 2027. This window has become exceptionally crowded, especially after some games like Fable pivoted from a fall 2026 release to early 2027 to avoid the blast zone of GTA 6. This will not only give God of War some space to breathe, but also other games that may not be as high on the priority list for gamers compared to a new first-party PlayStation game.
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：劳菲》此前原定于2027年2月16日发售。这个时间段已经变得异常拥挤，尤其是在《神鬼寓言》等一些游戏为了避开《GTA6》的冲击范围，将发售时间从2026年秋季转至2027年初之后。这不仅会给《战神》留出一些喘息空间，也会给其他游戏留出空间；与一款新的PlayStation第一方游戏相比，玩家的优先游玩名单上这些游戏的排名可能没有那么高。

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey has been met with a lot of skepticism and criticism from some gamers , partially due to the fact Kratos has been sidelined as the main character. As a result, it will be important for Santa Monica Studio to be on their A-game and deliver something exceptional. If there's anything that falls short of expectations, the internet will ruthlessly pick it apart, regardless of it's actually fair to do so.
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：劳菲》遭到了一些玩家的大量质疑和批评，部分原因是奎托斯不再担任主角，而是被放到了次要位置。因此，对圣莫妮卡工作室来说，拿出最佳状态并交付一部出色的作品将十分重要。如果有任何地方未能达到预期，网络上的人都会毫不留情地加以挑剔，无论这样做实际上是否公平。

paragraphs.en: The decision to delay the game must have been made relatively recently, as the studio had just announced a collector's box that was designed to coincide with the game's release date in February. It's unclear if that collector's box will be delayed as well, as it doesn't include the game and therefore is just a box of merch.
paragraphs.cn: 延期游戏的决定一定是最近才做出的，因为工作室刚刚公布了一个收藏盒，原计划配合游戏2月的发售日期推出。目前尚不清楚该收藏盒是否也会延期，因为它不包含游戏，所以只是一盒周边商品。

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey will be one of the biggest games of 2027, as it will continue the story Sony Santa Monica set in motion back in 2018. Although Laufey is the protagonist, it is expected to overlap and connect back to the last two games, with Kratos also having a role in the new game. It's unclear what kind of larger implications and ramifications God of War Laufey will have on this universe, but it seems like a pretty significant expansion of the franchise . A new Kratos-led God of War game is also actively in the works .
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：劳菲》将成为2027年最受瞩目的游戏之一，因为它将延续索尼圣莫妮卡工作室早在2018年开启的故事。尽管劳菲是主角，但这款游戏预计会与前两部作品有所交集并产生联系，奎托斯也将在新游戏中扮演一个角色。目前尚不清楚《战神：劳菲》将对这个宇宙产生何种更广泛的影响和后果，但它似乎是对该系列的一次相当重大的拓展。一款由奎托斯担任主角的全新《战神》游戏也正在积极开发中。
